title: HUMKIN RADIO — Humans and Other Intelligences
document_status: Return Signal source proposal; deployment not verified
description: One shared music program, with public read-only entry points and explicit proof limits.

live_hls.truth: public audio transport; a request or manifest does not prove successful playback

broadcast_status.truth: transmitter/Worker status, not independent proof of what a phone or autonomous agent heard

human_catalog.truth: static rotation candidate; not an authoritative live lineup or proof of every published recording

return_signal.truth: Bounded returned machine observations, not listeners or audience measurements.

participation.listening_claims: only an actual playback client may assert its locally witnessed receipt; accessing metadata is not listening
participation.proposed_programming: requires separate owner review and station-authorized publication; not enabled here
participation.public_music_analysis: requires source identity, permission and independent review before any public projection
participation.automated_play_counts: robot requests must not be presented as human listeners
participation.correspondence: Public read-only. Owner-reviewed internal agent interpretations can be published through the restricted repository workflow, tied to retained Signal Ear sample IDs. Outside submissions and autonomous DJ actions remain disabled.

provenance.authority: HUMKIN catalog + authorized broadcaster remain authoritative; reLATTE receipts do not grant publishing power
